paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the values of three metrics, identified in the legend as AU, TU, and EU, measured across various decoding temperatures. The x-axis is labeled "Decoding Temperature" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with no specified units, marked at regular intervals of 0.2. The y-axis lacks a specific text label but employs a linear scale with numeric ticks ranging from 0.000 to 0.175 at regular intervals of 0.025. The line representing AU is a solid red-orange line with solid circular markers; it begins at approximately 0.125 at an x-value of 0.0, remains relatively steady to an x-value of 0.2, dips slightly to roughly 0.123 at an x-value of 0.4, and then rises to end at its peak of approximately 0.185 at an x-value of 0.8. The line for TU is depicted as a solid blue line with solid circular markers; it starts at approximately 0.127 at an x-value of 0.0, stays relatively flat to 0.128 at an x-value of 0.2, decreases slightly to approximately 0.124 at an x-value of 0.4, and subsequently increases to end at a peak value of approximately 0.186 at an x-value of 0.8. The line for EU is shown as a solid green line with solid circular markers; it begins at a value of approximately 0.002 at an x-value of 0.0 and maintains a steady, flat trend across the entire axis, concluding at the same value of roughly 0.002 at an x-value of 0.8.
